name: Kotou Yotogibanashi
source:
Suffering from fatigue and depression, the man one day came across the Fox Lantern Inn.
He went in for a meal, and was greeted rather shockingly by a young girl with ears and a tail.

She was a wish-giver named Marie. She enticed him with an offer of sex.

Pass time in a pleasant way with a girl who transforms into an animal.
This is a story about what happiness can be, and how it's different for humans and animals.

A voiced romance ADV about the love between a human and a changeling.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ127762.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
饱受疲劳和抑郁之苦的男子有一天偶然发现了狐灯客栈。
他进去吃饭，迎接他的是一个长着耳朵和尾巴的年轻女孩，这让他颇为震惊。

她是一位名叫玛丽的许愿者。她用性行为引诱了他。

与变身为动物的少女一起愉快地度过时光。
这是一个关于幸福是什么以及它对人类和动物有何不同的故事。

一部关于人类和幻形灵之间爱情的有声浪漫ADV。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ127762.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
